title: Gwead SPI definition
description: An SPI role contract: the set of actions a plugin claiming the role must (or may) provide, with JSON Schemas for each action's input and output. Documents are classified as SPI definitions when they carry a top-level `actions` map in which no action has `steps`.

formatVersion.description: SPI definition format version. Optional; absent means 1 (the only version so far). Declared so future format revisions can be detected up front instead of misparsed.

name.description: SPI role name (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE by convention). Registry key; plugins claim it via their `roles` list, and it appears verbatim in `invoke:role:<name>` grants — hence the identifier grammar: ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `-`, not starting with `-`, at most 128 bytes. `/` is reserved as the namespace separator.

version.description: Contract version. Additive minor revisions mark new actions `optional: true` so older plugins stay conformant.

actions.description: Action name → contract. Actions here carry input/output schemas and never `steps`.

$defs.description: Shared JSON Schema definitions referenced from action schemas via `#/$defs/<Name>`.

streamEventShape.description: For streaming roles: a JSON Schema describing the shape of each streamed event.

input.description: JSON Schema for the action's input.

output.description: JSON Schema for the action's output.

optional.description: When true, plugins claiming this role may omit the action.
